574-1981-2415-3845.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-3845.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1445-1913-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-3899-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-2350-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2350-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

728-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

224-575-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
224-575-5971-7097.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Retreat to Coralhelm and Zimone trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

411-4613-4924.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus' ability by paying {1} due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1475-5256-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1462-6801-6991.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-6801-6991.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-6801-6991.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

1746-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

518-5938-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional {1}{R}{R} available or control a nontoken red creature that you can sacrifice.
518-5938-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-5938-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost or by sacrificing a nontoken red creature, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

1170-3389-5334-5954-6763.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2122-2313-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-2313-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2060-3525-3574-4029.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3525-3574-4029.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3525-3574-4029.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

678-4766-5330.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken artifact creature you control.
678-4766-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2508-2580-3263.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Lethal Vapors triggers, destroying that creature.
Because Collector Ouphe prevents Lethal Vapors's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

Venser enters the battlefield, returning Jeweled Lotus to your hand.

2174-3230-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.

Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Bloom Tender.
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
3525-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

864-2292-3622-4766.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness dies, triggering Deathrender, putting Gravedigger from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Gravedigger enters the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravedigger.
Gravedigger dies, triggering Deathrender, putting Eternal Witness from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
